subject: Post-call: Buy‑flow playbook, stakeholder roster & legal routing plan
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Dana Whitman <dana.whitman@brightlinehealth.com>, Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T09:06:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Buy‑flow playbook, stakeholder roster & legal routing plan

Hi Dana / Tom —

Thanks again for the time this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Summary of needs we heard
- Decision criteria: predictable latency (p95 < 120ms for interactive flows), regional hosting in us‑east, robust audit logs and retention controls, and a DPA that matches HIPAA-adjacent controls.
- Primary stakeholders: Tom (economic buyer/ops), Dana (security/compliance), Lisa Chen (procurement) will own SOW/PO.

Suggested buying path and owners (Redwood side)
- NDA: mutual NDA to start; target turnaround 1–3 business days once routed to legal.
- Security evidence & SOC2: we’ll provide attestation and the completed questionnaire (attached). Stephanie will lead SOC2 evidence and technical controls.
- DPA/MSA: once economics are agreed, route to procurement/legal for redlines. Ben will coordinate legal handoff and track redline cadence (typical 5–10 business days for first review).

Attachments I’m including: Brightline_SOW_draft_v1.docx (initial scope), Redwood_security_questionnaire_filled.pdf.

Proposed immediate next steps
1) Tom / Lisa to confirm procurement contact and preferred NDA routing (email to legal@brightlinehealth.com or DocuSign).
2) We (Redwood) to circulate a concise buy-flow checklist and legal routing map for signoff by EOD tomorrow.
3) Stephanie to share SOC2 summary and sample DPA clauses that map to your requirements.

If that sounds right I’ll put Ben on the thread to kick off NDA routing and track timelines.

Thanks —
Priya Natarajan
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com | (415) 555-0124

From: Dana Whitman <dana.whitman@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T10:31:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Buy‑flow playbook, stakeholder roster & legal routing plan

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from security/procurement: 

- Please add our procurement lead Lisa Chen (lisa.chen@brightlinehealth.com) as the primary PO/SOW contact. Procurement will want the SOW + cost sheet before routing the MSA.
- For security: we need the SOC2 Type II report (or an AICPA letter) plus the completed questionnaire you attached. Please confirm whether Redwood will be willing to sign a limited-risk DPA (we can share reference language).
- For the NDA: route to legal@brightlinehealth.com and cc me. They prefer DocuSign for faster turnaround.

One more ask: can you confirm where customer data would be stored (region/retention) and whether the KV cache is cleared on customer request? Those are gating for my review.

Dana Whitman
Head of InfoSec | Brightline Health
dana.whitman@brightlinehealth.com | (212) 555-4482

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Dana Whitman <dana.whitman@brightlinehealth.com>, Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@brightlinehealth.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Buy‑flow playbook, stakeholder roster & legal routing plan

Thanks Dana — good points. Looping on proposed routing and owners so we have a single source of truth. (Quoting Dana for context: "route to legal@brightlinehealth.com and cc me".)

Redwood routing plan (owners & estimated turn times)
- Phase 0 (NDA): Priya to send mutual NDA via DocuSign to legal@brightlinehealth.com. Target: 1–3 business days once in their queue. Owner: Priya (deal lead).
- Phase 1 (Security intake): Stephanie to send SOC2 summary, control mappings, and confirm technical answers to your KV/cache question. Target: same day delivery for summary; deeper evidence within 2 business days. Owner: Stephanie Nguyen (Security).
- Phase 2 (Commercials & SOW): Priya to provide a cost sheet and updated SOW. Procurement (Lisa) to confirm PO path. Target: 2–3 business days to get cost sheet to procurement.
- Phase 3 (MSA/DPA redlines): Ben to receive initial redlines and coordinate legal review. Expected first-pass turnaround: 5–10 business days depending on scope. Owner: Ben Carter (Legal handoff).

Quick answers to Dana’s gating questions:
- Data residency: Brightline data would be hosted in us‑east (primary). We can provide region-specific hosting for PHI-adjacent workloads as part of the Private deployment conversation.
- KV cache: Redwood offers configurable KV/prefix caching. By default caches persist across sessions for performance; we support programmatic cache flush on request and can document retention policies in the DPA.

I’ve attached a one-page legal_routing_owner_map.pdf that lays this out visually and includes our internal contacts.

Would it help if we pushed the NDA via DocuSign now (Priya)? If we can get that signed today, we’ll circulate the SOW + cost sheet to Lisa immediately.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Head of Revenue Ops | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Tom Hayes <tom.hayes@brightlinehealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Dana Whitman <dana.whitman@brightlinehealth.com>
Date: 2028-07-19T17:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Buy‑flow playbook, stakeholder roster & legal routing plan

Thanks — this is helpful and aligns with internal expectations. Please go ahead and send the NDA to legal@brightlinehealth.com via DocuSign and copy me and Lisa (cc’d). If we can get a signed NDA today, procurement will prioritize review of the SOW and we’ll aim for a PO within one week.

Tom Hayes
VP, Operations | Brightline Health
tom.hayes@brightlinehealth.com | (617) 555-2270
